name: City, Toronto Open Data
freeEvidence: Official city open-data licence permits royalty-free reuse including commercial purposes. Public catalog metadata API is documented in its own help response. Attribute Open Government Licence - Toronto and retain dataset-specific restrictions.

name: City, Helsinki
freeEvidence: HRI official terms generally license data and associated metadata CC BY 4.0, permitting commercial and non-commercial reuse with publisher attribution. Exceptions are specified per dataset; official open-data guidance confirms free of charge.

name: City, Gdańsk
freeEvidence: Official city service publishes open data from Gdansk city hall and other entities and links CKAN API documentation. Public metadata search is keyless and has no published tariff; underlying resource licences still apply.

name: Brreg
freeEvidence: Official open data API uses Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD). It is freely available for reuse with attribution, including economic activities; personal data retain their separate legal protections.

name: Data.parliament.uk
freeEvidence: Official Parliament API publishes keyless JSON reads. Open Parliament Licence grants royalty-free commercial and non-commercial reuse. Attribute Contains Parliamentary information licensed under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0; personal-data and third-party exceptions remain.
